fullDescription: CL reminds to clean the intake filter every 2 weeks.

title: Bucket Removed

fullDescription: P2 shows if bucket is removed or improperly seated.

title: LG AS — Room Temperature Sensor (Dehumidifier)
shortDescription: LG Dehumidifier error AS: The room temperature thermistor on the dehumidifier is out of range.
fullDescription: Error code AS on LG dehumidifiers indicates the room temperature thermistor on the dehumidifier is out of range. This condition normally locks out cooling or heating until the fault is cleared. Common causes include a defective room temperature thermistor, a loose or damaged wiring harness between the component and the main control board, or a failure of the control board itself. Begin with a hard power reset, then inspect the room temperature thermistor and its wiring before considering board replacement.
symptoms: AS shown on the indoor display or remote
Compressor or fan does not start

fixSteps.title: Power reset
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect the unit from power for 5 minutes, then restore power and observe whether the error returns.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Open the service panel and verify all connectors at the main control board are fully seated and undamaged.

fixSteps.title: Test the suspect component
fixSteps.instruction: Use a multimeter to verify resistance or continuity of the affected sensor or component, and compare against service manual specs.

fixSteps.title: Replace the failed part
fixSteps.instruction: Order the matching replacement part for your model, install it in the same orientation, and reconnect all wiring before re-testing.

whenToCallPro: If basic checks do not clear the AS code, an HVAC technician should be called to verify refrigerant pressures and inverter operation.

faq.q: What does AS mean on a LG dehumidifier?
faq.a: The room temperature thermistor on the dehumidifier is out of range.

faq.q: Can I run my LG dehumidifier with AS?
faq.a: No — most units lock out operation when AS is active. Resolve the fault before continued use.
